_note: All page wording lives here. Placeholders: {season} season label, {team} short name (Lakers), {full_team} full name, {arena}, {city}, {away}/{home} short names, {away_full}/{home_full} full names. Titles are cut to 60 characters and descriptions to 155. While launched is false every page carries noindex and sitemap.xml lists no URLs (page hashes and lastmod dates are still tracked, so they are right on launch day). Never say a price is the lowest anywhere: SeatGeek's lowest_price is 'the lowest listed on SeatGeek'.

hub.premium_intro: How much more (or less) a team's road games cost than the host's usual home game. For each road game we divide its get-in price by the host's average get-in price, then take the median across the team's road games. 1.25x means road games with this team cost 25% more than the host's average night.
